<mujoco model="editor_acceptance">
  <compiler angle="radian"/>

  <option integrator="implicitfast"/>

  <worldbody>
    <geom name="floor" size="5 5 0.1" type="plane"/>
    <body name="arm" pos="0 0 1.5">
      <joint name="hinge" range="-1.5 1.5" damping="0.35" axis="0 1 0"/>
      <geom name="arm_geom" size="0.1 0.1 0.4" pos="0 0 -0.4" type="box" mass="2"/>
    </body>
    <body name="api_box" pos="0 0 2">
      <joint name="api_box_free" type="free"/>
      <geom name="api_box_geom" size="0.25 0.25 0.25" type="box" rgba="0.3 0.6 0.85 1"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>

  <actuator>
    <general name="position_drive" joint="hinge" ctrlrange="-1.5 1.5" input="pos" biastype="affine" gainprm="20" biasprm="0 -20 -2"/>
    <general name="velocity_drive" joint="hinge" input="vel" biastype="affine" biasprm="0 0 -1"/>
    <general name="motor_drive" joint="hinge"/>
  </actuator>
</mujoco>
